notes.title: Work on the demo is well underway!
notes.content: [p]Hey fans![/p][p]We're working on the demo full time, in order to bring it to you crisp and flawless. I know we originally optimistically promised the demo in August, which is already past us... But, better to give you something worthy than half baked goods, I believe! This time, we're really getting closer to publishing it.[/p][p][/p][p][img src="{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/45577947/f275d321e269d1e9399c72c565c07738b6cf0416.png"][/img][/p][p]To give you a glimpse of what we're doing:[/p][list][*][p][b]We've decided to hire a voice actor for Tobias, and we're currently dealing with a few candidates. 💬[/b][/p][p]When playing other adventures I realized how important the voice acting actually is. And AI can't still cut it. So, we decided to hire a VA, at least for the main character, even though we're releasing only the demo. Other voices will be still made by AI, though, because we don't have the resources (mostly time) right now to do it. The full game will be completely made with VA, though![/p][/*][*][p][b]We're finalizing the locations & gameplay. 🌲[/b][/p][p]There were some last minute decisions to redo parts of the demo, since I felt it's not "good-enough". A little delay that's definitely worth it.[/p][/*][*][p][b]I'm producing the soundtrack. 🎷[/b][/p][p]I always wanted to make the music for the game. There was a time where I almost decided to hire an external musician, because I already do a lot - but then I said "Screw it, music is my passion, I'll not take this away from myself." And it was for good! The soundtrack currently have 4 songs, from orchestral menu music to suspensful drones, and I have to add a few more to cover the demo.[/p][/*][*][p][b]We're finishing the support game systems. 💻[/b][/p][p]Menus, GUI, save system... We can't release it without! 😄[/p][/*][*][p][b]Preparing the playtest & PR. 🎉[/b][/p][p]If you're [u]interested in playtesting, let me know[/u] (find me on discord @moodhuntz)! If you have a youtube channel or are a streamer and [u]want to cover the demo in your channels, also let me know[/u] and we work something out. For example, we may might give you an early access 😜.[/p][/*][*][p][b]Making a new gameplay trailer. 🎞️[/b][/p][p]The demo deserves a proper introduction through a new trailer! And we haven't showed much of the actual gameplay, so this is the time.[/p][p][/p][/*][/list][p]So, what can you look forward to?[/p][list][*][p][b]Almost 1 hour of gameplay.[/b][/p][p]Actually, that's a lot! We're thinking of reducing the scope.[/p][/*][*][p][b]Meeting 3 main and 3 secondary characters.[/b][/p][p]Includes Tobias, Juno and mage Thaddeus ✨.[/p][/*][*][p][b]6 distinct locations and full intro.[/b][/p][p]Telling the story from the beginning.[/p][/*][/list][p][/p][p]Now, no more talking and let me get back to work 😄![/p][p][/p][p]All best,[/p][p]Jaromír[/p]

notes.title: Demo Approaching & Steam Page Overhaul
notes.content:
[p]We've been hard at work on the demo we promised to bring you in September! This demo will cover the beginning of the game and last around 30–60 minutes — enough for you to dive into the story and see for yourself whether we're living up to our promises:[/p][list][*][p]Gorgeous pixel art graphics and immersive SFX & music[/p][/*][*][p]Interesting, atmospheric locations and characters[/p][/*][*][p]A captivating story that pulls you in[/p][/*][*][p]And yes… we even snuck in a few jokes! 😄[/p][/*][/list][p]We're pushing to deliver on schedule, and so far everything is on track for September. In the meantime, we've also improved the game visuals and refreshed the logo — let us know what you think![/p][p]
[img src="{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/45577947/af2e0408c4ef245a05345bb5d0e4c140455d8e75.png"][/img][/p][p]Last but not least, enjoy some [b]new screenshots[/b]![/p][p][img src="{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/45577947/f980134b72e40dd504c8031459846d680192d4f0.png"][/img][/p][p][img src="{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/45577947/b4ee2cd9788d347441450ad9b4978d67a5f3d760.png"][/img][/p][p][img src="{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/45577947/1050c5e498bff3004f1ff41fa178d7c37cca76d5.png"][/img][/p][p][img src="{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/45577947/584c61c8cdf3a17dc4331935cb49e51bc569a345.png"][/img][/p][p]Thanks for your support! 
Jaromír @ MOD42[/p]

notes.title: Two Realms: Whispers from the Rift announced
notes.content:
After three months of work, I'm so excited to share this great news with you — the official announcement of our P&C adventure game Two Realms: Whispers from the Rift. Additionally, I'm pleased to show you the announcement trailer, which will tell you a bit about the game.

[previewyoutube=wfAwH9KFnFc;full][/previewyoutube]
In this story-rich point-and-click adventure, you play as Tobias, a young commoner from a fishing village. After finding a mysterious crystal, his brother suddenly falls ill, and Tobias is forced into a knowledge-seeking journey to save him. But he is not prepared for what he is about to discover...

We're already cooking something more for you — [b]we expect to have a playable demo ready around the middle of the year![/b] Until then, be sure to follow our progress here on steam, and if you want to reach out to me directly, you can do so on our [url=https://discord.gg/Gcm4n3t9GK]Discord[/url] channel.

But most importantly — spread the word. We're making this game for people like you, and we want our game to be played. And I'm absolutely looking forward to the day we release it and see it being played.

Jaromír @ MOD42
